sentences.text: REPACSS measures every watt, and the shape of every waveform.
GLEAMM's phasor measurement units and protective relays sample voltage and current across the facility.
That reveals power quality, including harmonic distortion: the extra frequencies that power supplies add to the clean 60 hertz wave.
The team studies how different workloads, and even individual codes, change those signatures.
It also measures the total energy each code uses, so researchers can see what a result really costs.
Measurement drives a research challenge: remote data center management.
A facility on variable energy cannot wait for someone to walk the machine room floor.
Telemetry streams from every node, power, temperature, and utilization, so operators can watch and act remotely.
A private control network reaches the UPS, the power distribution units, and the in-row coolers.
